src.title: How to Make French Toast!! Classic Quick and Easy Recipe

recipes.title: Classic French Toast (Texas toast)

items.i: slices Texas toast or thick-cut bread (about 3/4 inch)
butter and vegetable oil, for cooking

steps: In a pie plate, beat the eggs, then whisk in the milk, sugar, cinnamon, salt and vanilla until completely smooth.
Heat about 1 tsp oil and a small pat of butter over medium to medium-high heat until the butter's milk solids just start to brown.
Re-whisk the batter, then dip a slice quickly on each side (don't soak it) and let the excess drip off.
Cook without moving for about 2 minutes until golden underneath and the bubbles around the edge calm down, then flip and cook 1–2 minutes more. Add a little butter and oil between slices.
Top with maple syrup and a dusting of powdered sugar.
recipes.notes: Recipe is the creator's (2 eggs covers 6 slices); macros are estimated per 2 slices, before syrup. A quick dip instead of a soak keeps the center bready rather than custardy.
